intro: The Sienna unit helps you stay organised without taking up extra space. Strong, stylish, and designed for modern homes, it holds books, plants, and décor while fitting neatly into any room.

features.title: Compact design that fits anywhere
features.text: Designed for small spaces, our vertical bookshelf makes the most of every inch—perfect for apartments, cosy corners, or rooms that need extra storage without taking up too much space.

features.title: Open and closed storage for all needs
features.text: With multiple shelves, there’s space for everything—books, collectibles, plants, or your favourite décor pieces—so your home feels organised and personal.

features.title: Strong enough for heavy books
features.text: Built with a sturdy frame, this unit can handle large books, decorative items, and everyday essentials without bending or wobbling.

features.title: A modern look that works in any space
features.text: The wood and grey finish adds a stylish touch that fits into any home—whether your style is modern, classic, or somewhere in between.

features.title: Knockdown construction for easy assembly
features.text: Its simple knockdown design ensures hassle-free setup and relocation, perfectly suited for evolving spaces and contemporary living.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
